value.rationale: The complete irredundant-seed classification refines the well-known minimal infection threshold on a canonical 16-vertex cube into every symmetry configuration and every synchronous completion time. The induced forest tree-component geometry explains why 160 seven-seed sets finish in three rounds and 768 in four, a natural efficiency tradeoff independent of minimum cardinality. The result is an exact finite classification, not an arbitrary slice or unsupported general-dimensional theorem.
